summary: Hiker fell on his descent from Ellingwood Point, ended up off-route and unable to descend; spent Friday night on the mountain in severe storms; hoisted by a Colorado National Guard Blackhawk at ~6 a.m. July 27 to the Lake Como helipad; treated and released from hospital
responding_agency: AVSAR, Colorado National Guard, Alpine Rescue Team (assist)
notes: 54140, 14ers forum thread titled 'Serious fall on Ellingwood Point on 8/4' appears to refer to this incident; actual incident date per AVSAR release is July 26-27, 2024 (July 26 was the Friday). Thread not opened (browser tool failure) Conejos County Citizen sister-paper copy of the AVSAR release (opened 2026-09-12, John Waters byline): AVSAR 4x4 team reached within 300 vertical ft of the hiker on day one, bedded down at nightfall, CO National Guard hoist at 6 a.m. Saturday July 27 to the Lake Como helipad, REACH29 to hospital at 6:45 a.m., treated and released; Alpine Rescue Team assisted with the State SAR Coordinator.
